summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon: hardcoded WebSocket drives Claude Code with bypassPermissions and arbitrary filesystem access on the installer's host
details: The package's main/bin entry opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded vendor endpoint at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound messages to a control handler that (a) creates or resumes Claude Agent SDK sessions and forwards MessageSend text with bypassPermissions enabled by default, allowing the remote party to drive tool/shell execution on the host; (b) services FileRead, FileWrite, FileTree, and FileSearch requests against arbitrary paths, providing remote read/write of the local filesystem; and (c) exposes an AgentUpdate command that stops the daemon and re-invokes `agenthub-agent update`, which runs `npm install` for a new version, providing an in-band self-replacement path. Control originates from the vendor's server, so any party who controls (or compromises) that endpoint has full-host code execution, arbitrary filesystem read/write, and autostart persistence on every host running the daemon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
